## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release approval check must be fixed before merge: changing `>=` to `>` rejects a release that holds exactly the minimum number of approvals, which contradicts the module's own docstring. The middle of the catalog diff was checked by line shape only, so the name-to-port pairing of those entries is not covered.

## Changes
The pull request renames all 1500 entries in `aaa-generated/catalog.json` from `legacy-service-NNNN` to `production-service-NNNN`, moves their ports from the 10000 range to the 20000 range, and adds one top-level `review_note` key. It also rewrites `healthy` in `services/registry.py` as `not failures` and changes the comparison in `approved` in `zzz-release/gate.py` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` in the release approval check — `approved(2)` with the default `minimum=2` now returns `False`, where the base returned `True`. The docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1` still reads "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." — Every release with exactly the minimum number of approvals is blocked, and no test in `tests/test_release.py` exercises `approvals == minimum`. — Fix: Extend `tests/test_release.py` with the `approvals == minimum` case so the boundary is pinned.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the non-service `review_note` key from the catalog — The added top-level `review_note` entry maps to a string, while each of the 1500 service entries maps to an object with `port` and `enabled`. A consumer that reads `entry["port"]` for every catalog value raises `TypeError` on this entry. — Catalog consumers must special-case one non-service key; this repository contains no consumer, so no current failure was traced.

## Not reviewed
- `aaa-generated/catalog.json`: lines 2234–8995 of `../pr.diff` were not read; they were only counted against the expected line shapes, so the name-to-port pairing of those entries is unchecked.
